**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

Locations investigated:
- **§ 2 LICENSE (p0021–p0029)** — the grant is non-exclusive and, in the same paragraph, expressly preserves our freedom to acquire, develop or license competing software and services; the only conditions are non-infringement of TrueLink IP and our § 10 confidentiality obligations.
- **§ 8 Client covenants (p0050–p0058)** — compliance with law, no representation that TrueLink makes underwriting decisions, access controls, Client Content warranties, anti-spam. No business or product restriction.
- **§ 7 anti-spam (p0049)**, **§ 5/6 compensation**, **§ 10 confidentiality**, **§ 12–30 boilerplate** — no field-of-use, territory or competing-products covenant binding us.

Noted in the rationale rather than flagged:
1. The § 2(a) field limitation ("ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables") limits use of TrueLink's Interface only — it is licence scope, not a covenant restricting what we may operate, build or buy, and it is immediately followed by the express freedom-to-compete sentence.
2. § 8(d) refers to a "Non-Competition Agreement" that is neither defined nor attached; as used it only limits TrueLink's rights in Credit Data (favourable to us). Worth diligence on that side agreement, but it creates no restriction on us in this document.
